title: THE ENIGMA OF THE ZODIAC KILLER

scenes.query: San Francisco streets with Zodiac symbols
scenes.text: Five confirmed victims, yet the killer was never caught.
He sent taunting letters to the press, including ciphers.
The last confirmed letter was sent in 1974.
Despite extensive investigations, the identity is still unknown.
Follow for daily true crime mysteries.

description: The Zodiac Killer remains one of the most infamous unsolved crimes in history. His story continues to intrigue and baffle investigators. Stay tuned for more true crime insights!
